div.span: The guard admits each call, enforces the call kind’s budget (sniff 5 s, import 120 s, transform 250 ms a record, hook 5 s) and turns panics into errors attributed to the plugin. After three panics or overruns the plugin is quarantined until Health::reset. Remote calls get 0.9 × the budget.
